source: public: xz-utils CVE-2024-3094 supply-chain backdoor, Mar 2024

input.description: A distro package build pulls xz 5.6.1; sshd links liblzma and an extra ifunc resolver hooks RSA_public_decrypt, adding ~500ms to failed logins.
signals: sshd latency anomaly on auth failure

labels.rationale_for_label: Deliberately planted upstream backdoor granting SSH RCE; a genuine supply-chain compromise.
